turns.text: hi! can u make me a digestive system study sheet graphic? its for dr. okoye's anatomy class, we did digestion this morning at 9

Sure! To make it match what you need, tell me a bit about the layout. Do you want it as a diagram with labels, a table, or a flowchart from mouth to the end of the tract? And do you have a color system I should follow?

flowchart pls, mouth down to the end. colors to match my notebook: pink for muscles, blue for bones, green for nerves, and yellow for the stuff likely on the exam. same highlight style as the yellow list pls

Got it. I'll use pink for muscles, blue for bones, green for nerves, and yellow highlighting for exam-likely items, in the same highlighter style as your yellow list. Since I can't see that list, I'll make the yellow a bold marker-style highlight behind the text and leave you a few blank yellow slots to add your own. Anything you want in the yellow already?
stomach regions, sphincters, and the small intestine segments. also pls add extra detail on the absorption and nutrient parts, thats my fav section
Nice, I'll expand that part. Anything else, like layout or size?
needs to be printable and easy to read really quick. im closing at the cafe tonight and will look at it on my break

Then I'll go single page, letter size, high-contrast, big headings, minimal text per box so it scans in seconds.

[Image: A portrait, letter-size flowchart titled "Digestive System" on a white background, flowing top to bottom with arrows. Boxes in order: Mouth (pink: tongue, chewing muscles; green: cranial nerve branches for taste and chewing; blue: jaw and hard palate) → Esophagus (pink: smooth and skeletal muscle, peristalsis) → Stomach (yellow highlight: cardia, fundus, body, pylorus; yellow: lower esophageal sphincter and pyloric sphincter) → Small intestine (yellow highlight: duodenum, jejunum, ileum; yellow: ileocecal valve) → Large intestine (cecum, colon, rectum; pink: anal sphincters).

A wider boxed section on the right is titled "Absorption & Nutrients" with extra detail: villi and microvilli increase surface area; carbs absorbed as glucose and fructose in the small intestine; proteins as amino acids and small peptides; fats packaged into chylomicrons and taken up by lacteals; vitamins and minerals absorbed along the jejunum and ileum; bile salts and B12 reabsorbed in the ileum; water mostly absorbed in the large intestine. Key terms in bold, with a small legend strip at the bottom showing pink, blue, green and yellow.]

I left three empty yellow-highlighted lines at the bottom for anything from your own list. Want me to adjust anything, like moving the absorption section or making the text bigger?
perfect thank u!! ok im gonna eat now
Good plan, eat something before your shift! Good luck studying on your break. ☕
